headline: ArMee Infotech drops Bondada EPC project from its order book
hook: Order book shrinks before listing fully settles
summary: ArMee Infotech Limited has disclosed under SEBI regulations that it failed to execute the Bondada EPC project, which was previously part of the order book in its Red Herring Prospectus. The company informed the stock exchange regarding this cancellation. Indian retail investors tracking micro-cap IPOs should note this development as it impacts the reported order book size used during the public offering.
why_it_matters: Reported pre-IPO order book overstated by one major project.
